data.title: Numbers at the desk

memoryNodes.cue: Rows and columns organise the numbers.
The graph shows changes through an afternoon.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 图表显示一个下午的变化。

data.situation:
After the two afternoons, Maya spread the records across a long desk. The figures showed how many visitors had chosen each area of the room. Jo used a calculator to calculate the average number of visitors per hour. Maya put the totals in a table with labelled rows and columns. Beside it, she drew a graph so that a change across the afternoon was easier to see. To Dr Chen
We have organised the figures, but we have not finished interpreting them. The statistics describe these two afternoons only. Could you help us analyse the results and check whether our graph is clear? We do not want to present a larger claim than the records support.

readingBlocks.en: After the two afternoons, Maya spread the records across a long desk. The figures showed how many visitors had chosen each area of the room. Jo used a calculator to calculate the average number of visitors per hour. Maya put the totals in a table with labelled rows and columns. Beside it, she drew a graph so that a change across the afternoon was easier to see.
readingBlocks.zh: 两个下午结束后，玛雅把记录摊在书桌上。数字显示各区域有多少访客选择。乔用计算器计算每小时平均访客人数。玛雅把总数放入有明确行列标题的表格。旁边，她画了图，使下午随时间发生的变化更容易看清。

readingBlocks.en:
To Dr Chen
We have organised the figures, but we have not finished interpreting them. The statistics describe these two afternoons only. Could you help us analyse the results and check whether our graph is clear? We do not want to present a larger claim than the records support.
readingBlocks.zh:
致陈博士
我们已经整理数字，但尚未完成解释。这些统计数据仅描述两个下午。您能帮忙分析结果，并检查图表是否清楚吗？我们不想提出比记录所支持范围更大的主张。

glossary.note: figure/figures 此处数值，不是人物或图形。
glossary.example: The figures show the number of visitors in each area.
glossary.exampleZh: 这些数字显示各区域的访客人数。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Numerical information, not a digit, body or illustration.

glossary.note: calculate an amount/average；不是冒险盘算义。
glossary.example: Jo calculated the average number of visitors.

externalEvidence.definition: make a mathematical calculation or computation

glossary.zh: 按总数除以数量所得平均值的
glossary.note: 形容词，本例算术平均；不是平庸义。
glossary.example: They calculated the average number of visitors per hour.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们计算每小时平均访客人数。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Arithmetic average adjective; no forced median/modal/normative sense.

glossary.zh: 以行和列组织信息的表格
glossary.note: 本例数据表，区别于家具桌子。
glossary.example: The table has one row for each afternoon.
glossary.exampleZh: 表格每个下午对应一行。

externalEvidence.definition: a set of data arranged in rows and columns

glossary.zh: 展示数值关系或变化的图表
glossary.note: a graph；坐标中的数值关系，不把所有图片都称graph。
glossary.example: The graph shows changes over time.
glossary.exampleZh: 图表显示随时间的变化。

externalEvidence.definition: a visual representation of the relations between certain quantities plotted with reference to a set of axes

glossary.zh: 收集并整理的统计数字
glossary.note: 此处复数数据；统计学学科义待补。
glossary.example: These statistics describe two afternoons at the centre.
glossary.exampleZh: 这些统计数字描述中心的两个下午。

externalEvidence.definition: a datum that can be represented numerically

glossary.example: Dr Chen helped them analyse the results.
glossary.exampleZh: 陈博士帮助她们分析结果。

externalEvidence.definition: consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
